verdict.rationale: Windmill documents optional Error and Recovery Handlers for failed scheduled executions, which are dedicated error workflows. It also documents step-level retries on error and a `wm_failure` field that marks a run as failed. The evidence does not show flow-level error-handler steps for non-scheduled runs or any built-in failure notification. Missing for 10: documented flow-level error handler/error path for all runs, explicit failure notification channels (email/Slack/alerts), independent corroboration.

support.subject: As an ops user, I can define dedicated error-handling paths or error workflows and get notified when a run fails

citations.quote: optional Error and Recovery Handlers to deal with failed scheduled executions
upon error this step will be retried with a delay and a maximum number of attempts
A script or flow can return a top-level `wm_failure` field (string) to retag the run as a failure even though the runtime did not raise an error.
